scope: Sequential local Debug filesystem measurements, three samples per case/cache mode, frozen 16384-row eight-file Parquet source. Baseline overlaps final native compilation; candidate precedes E2Es. These are not randomized paired trials.
report_excerpt_scope: Complete input, executable, configuration, environment and collector provenance, all timing, memory and sort profiles; verbose Prometheus snapshots and shard profiles are omitted. Full report hashes are retained.
conclusion: Leading-prefix reuse removes exhaustive sort decoration. All exact answers agree. Complete-tuple and partial-term restarted medians are materially unchanged; warm medians improve in these observations. Deterministic tests establish bounded point membership, smaller retained pending lineage, and unique-source ownership submissions independently of timing.
